problem.observed: The baseline representation predicts held-out opposite labels at chance.
problem.interpreted: The representation may discard direction; extra capacity may not recover it.
problem.state_model_rationale: A paired signed toy makes information loss and capacity distinguishable.

evaluation.split: fixed train magnitudes 1-4 and held-out test magnitudes 5-6
evaluation.budget_rule: one deterministic CPU evaluation per reserved candidate

hypotheses.conditions: The paired evaluator maps opposite signs together.
hypotheses.falsifier: A capacity-matched directional control remains indistinguishable from the baseline.

hypotheses.statement: The baseline is capacity-limited while direction is already present.
hypotheses.conditions: A capacity increase improves the protected metric without changing representation.
hypotheses.falsifier: Capacity increase retains the information bound and does not improve accuracy.

methods.definition: Evaluate baseline, capacity-expanded absolute features, and a directional representation under the same ridge evaluator.
methods.complexity: O(n d^2 + d^3) for n samples and d features
